title: FOUNDATIONS OF THE ENTREPRENEURIAL MINDSET
description: Topics include evaluating entrepreneurial capabilities, creativity, business plan creation, opportunity assessment and feasibility analysis, business implementation, new product introduction, and seeking funds.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:
